title: Night-Currency Window Tracker
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightlog:entry
| eval days_ago=round((now()-_time)/86400,0)
| stats sum(eval(if(days_ago<=90,night_landings,0))) as recent_night_landings
| eval current=if(recent_night_landings>=3,"current","NOT current")
description: Tracks whether you are staying inside the practical window for night-currency experience.
value: Night flying confidence decays quietly if you are not watching the recency window.
implementation: Ingest flight-log entries with night-landing counts; calculate rolling night-currency status.
visualization: Single-value tile of recent night landings and current/not-current status.
grandmaExplanation: It watches whether your recent night flying practice is still fresh enough to stay comfortable and current.
